programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Elephant Country
programs.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers that has been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programs.title: Tiffany Haddish Does Shark Week
programs.desc: Tiffany Haddish's fantasy is to uncover the secrets of shark sex, sailing on the fanciest yachts surrounded by friendly sea creatures and pampered by a handsome merman.

programs.title: The Zoo: Giraffe in the City
programs.desc: A giraffe named Mashengo journeys from the Indiana Zoo to his new home in the Bronx  keepers hand-raise endangered ducklings and release them at the Central Park Children's Zoo  love is in the air for a pair of cloud rats.

programs.title: My Cat From Hell: Philly's Forgotten Cats
programs.desc: Jackson faces one of his greatest challenges when an old friend enlists his help  he is asked to put on a mass trapping event and recruit a new generation of volunteers to save community cats in Philadelphia.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Silent Scream
programs.desc: A polar bear chases down Erin Greene as she walks home from a Halloween party in a small arctic town  a bull shark attacks triathlete Chuck Anderson in the Gulf of Mexico, biting his arm and pulling him to the ocean floor.
